tickerText: [TENNIS] Linda Noskova fires 15 aces in a 6-2, 7-6(3) win over Katie Boulter on Sept. 22 to clinch the Czech Republic's 2-0 Billie Jean King Cup quarterfinal sweep in Shenzhen, while the ATP Chengdu and Hangzhou Opens open first-round play on Sept. 23 • [SQUASH] Amina Orfi holds the PSA women's world No. 1 spot after her Qatar Classic five-set final over Hania El Hammamy, with Mostafa Asal's straight-games title over Victor Crouin giving him every current major crown and his 30th tour win • [BADMINTON] Lakshya Sen saves eight match points, rallying from 13-19 in the decider to beat Kodai Naraoka 11-21, 21-5, 21-19 as India sweeps Japan 3-0 into men's team semis; An Se-young opens Korea's women's semi with a 2-1 win over Akane Yamaguchi • [PICKLEBALL] The Carvana PPA Tour rolls into the Rate Las Vegas Open on Sept. 28 with $1,063,327 in payouts and 1,000 ranking points per division, one week after Haworth, Waters, and Alshon/Daescu took Arizona Open gold • [TABLE TENNIS] Asian Games action on Sept. 23 features mixed doubles round of 16 plus men's and women's team semis in Nagoya; Manush Shah-Diya Chitale and Harmeet Desai-Yashaswini Ghorpade won mixed doubles Round 2 ties while India's men fell 0-3 to South Korea in the round of 16

newsItems.title: Sen's Epic Comeback
newsItems.excerpt: Lakshya Sen rallied from 13-19 in the third to beat Kodai Naraoka 11-21, 21-5, 21-19 on Sept. 23, sealing India's 3-0 men's team win over Japan and a semifinal date with China at the Asian Games.

newsItems.title: Noskova Clinches BJK Tie
newsItems.excerpt: Linda Noskova beat Katie Boulter 6-2, 7-6(3) on Sept. 22 with 15 aces and no break points faced, wrapping a 2-0 Czech Republic win over Great Britain and a Billie Jean King Cup semifinal berth in Shenzhen.

newsItems.title: India TT Pairs Advance
newsItems.excerpt: Manush Shah and Diya Chitale beat Sri Lanka 11-8, 12-10, 11-4, and Harmeet Desai with Yashaswini Ghorpade also won mixed doubles Round 2 on Sept. 23 as knockout singles and team semis continue in Nagoya.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Next Stop
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open runs Sept. 28-Oct. 4 at Darling Tennis Center with $1,063,327 in prize money, following Championship Sunday crowns for Christopher Haworth and Anna Leigh Waters in Mesa.
